label: AgMsv_1.1115
cite_parts:
dhyeyapūjyādivaicitryam ittham arthakriyākaram /
mūrto bhinnaḥ samāhūto hitvā bhogān nijān kṣaṇāt // [AgMsv_1.1115]
quick_english: Thus the variety of meditation, worship, and the like becomes effective in action: an embodied, divided deity, when invoked, can abandon its own enjoyments and act in an instant.

tokens.grounds: compound denoting diverse forms of meditation, worship, etc.
compound describing something that accomplishes practical ends

label: AgMsv_1.1116
cite_parts:
deva etīti vārtaiṣā vacaneṣv eva śobhate /
amūrtādisvarūpatvaṃ sarvam etat tu yujyate // [AgMsv_1.1116]
quick_english: Saying 'O god, he comes' is fitting only within scriptural statements; but all this is truly fitting only as the nature of the formless and so forth.

tokens.grounds: verb with quotative particle fused in the token
fused form referring to such a report or claim
locative plural with sandhi before eva
abstract state of being formless and so on
demonstrative referring to the preceding account

label: AgMsv_1.1117
cite_parts:
ātmaiva hi tathābhūtas tathā bhāty eva bhedataḥ /
evaṃ svabhāva evaiṣa saṃvido yaḥ sa eva tu // [AgMsv_1.1117]
quick_english: Indeed the self alone, being of that nature, appears just so through division; for this is the very nature of consciousness, and that alone is what appears.

label: AgMsv_1.1118
cite_parts:
bhedagrastatayā kārmo malaḥ śāstre nirūpyate /
dīkṣādikarmayoge tu na malatvaṃ pratāyate // [AgMsv_1.1118]
quick_english: In scripture the karmic impurity is defined as being seized by division; but in the practice of initiation and related rites, it is not regarded as an impurity.

tokens.grounds: instrumental abstract expressing domination by difference
related to action and its traces
compound locative referring to initiatory and ritual practice
the condition of being an impurity
is recognized or extended as such

label: AgMsv_1.1119
cite_parts:
sa hi bhedamayāśeṣasaṃsāradahanavrataḥ /
dīkṣā ca vastutas tādṛksatyasaṃvitsvarūpiṇī // [AgMsv_1.1119]
quick_english: For initiation is vowed to burning away the entire world of transmigration made of division; and in reality it is of the nature of that true consciousness.

tokens.grounds: demonstrative referring to the karmic factor or rite context
compound describing a vow to consume the whole world of division
from the standpoint of true nature
compound describing initiation as true awareness itself

label: AgMsv_1.1120
cite_parts:
evaṃ yo veda tattvenety uktaṃ cānuttare naye /
evaṃ vijñānayoge hi śamite bhedagocare // [AgMsv_1.1120]
quick_english: Thus it is said in the supreme doctrine: one who knows in this way knows in truth; for in the yoga of realization, when the sphere of division is quieted, this is understood.

tokens.grounds: fused connective and locative referring to the highest teaching
in the discipline of direct knowledge

label: AgMsv_1.1121
cite_parts:
ātmaiva śiva evaikaḥ ko bandhaḥ kā ca muktatā /
etaddīkṣāmahāsaṃvidpraveśāya tu bhaṇyate // [AgMsv_1.1121]
quick_english: The self alone is Śiva, the one reality—so what bondage is there, and what liberation? Yet this is taught for the sake of entry into the great consciousness of initiation.

label: AgMsv_1.1122
cite_parts:
kriyāsvabhāvadīkṣāsau karmādimalahānaye /
svabhāvakḷptaniyatibalākṣipteṣu karmasu // [AgMsv_1.1122]
quick_english: This initiation, whose nature is action, is for the removal of karmic and other impurities, operating within actions that are driven by the fixed force fashioned by nature.

tokens.grounds: fused compound referring to initiation characterized by ritual action
compound locative plural describing karmic actions governed by inherent necessity

label: AgMsv_1.1123
cite_parts:
bhogo 'sya yugapadyasmāt kriyate mantraśaktitaḥ /
tathā hi prāṇagā deśakalākālādhvaniścayāḥ // [AgMsv_1.1123]
quick_english: Because his experience is brought about simultaneously through the power of mantra, the determinations belonging to breath, space, limited agency, and time are likewise brought into play.

tokens.grounds: compound naming limiting determinations along the paths of space, limited agency, and time

label: AgMsv_1.1124
cite_parts:
jātayo 'sya pratāyante dharaṇyādiśivāntataḥ /
tatraiva janmasaṃbhogādhikāralayabhājanam // [AgMsv_1.1124]
quick_english: His births are unfolded from earth all the way up to Śiva, and right there he becomes subject to birth, experience, authority, and dissolution.

tokens.grounds: compound indicating the full range of levels
compound describing undergoing birth, enjoyment, office, and dissolution

label: AgMsv_1.1125
cite_parts:
vidhāyotkṛṣyate tasmād anyatra ca vidhīyate /

itthaṃ guror niścitasaṃvidātmarūḍheś ca śiṣyasya paraspareṇa /
niṣkarmacetor acitaiva dīkṣā prākkarmaśaktīr akhilā ruṇaddhi // [AgMsv_1.1125]
quick_english: Thus, having been arranged and elevated from one level and placed in another, initiation—through the mutual, non-conceptual meeting of a guru established in settled consciousness and a disciple of actionless mind—blocks all the powers of prior karma.

tokens.grounds: absolutive plus passive verb indicating elevation after arrangement
compound describing a guru or lord grounded in settled consciousness
compound with truncated genitive form indicating minds free of karmic action
fused instrumental-like form emphasizing non-conceptual means

label: AgMsv_1.1126
cite_parts:
tatrāpi taṇḍulatilājyacaruprabandha ityādi śaivaniyatipratibhārakḷptam /
tāvaty api sphuṭapade na niśāprapañco nirmūlatām upagato 'pi vibhedavṛtteḥ // [AgMsv_1.1126]
quick_english: Even there, the series of rice, sesame, ghee, oblations, and so forth—fashioned according to Śaiva necessity—does not, even at a clear stage, make the expanse of obscurity rootless, because division still continues to operate.

tokens.grounds: compound listing ritual substances and procedures
compound describing ritual forms shaped by Śaiva rule
in an explicit or manifest level
compound metaphorically suggesting obscurity or darkness
ablative/genitive sense indicating the persistence of differentiation

label: AgMsv_1.1127
cite_parts:
bhede 'pi kiṃtv eṣa punar bhaviṣyasaṃsārakārisukṛtādivighātahetuḥ /
śuddhas tatas tad ata eva hi tattvajālaṃ śuddhetarasthititayā nikhilaṃ dvidhaiva // [AgMsv_1.1127]
quick_english: Even within difference, this pure element destroys the merit that would cause future transmigration. For that reason, the entire network of principles is only twofold, divided into pure and other.

tokens.grounds: indeclinable, sandhi form of kiṃ tu
compound describing the cause of obstructing merit that produces future transmigration
instrumental expressing the mode of division

label: AgMsv_1.1128
cite_parts:
śuddhaṃ triśaktikhacitaṃ nanu yāmalaṃ ca bhāty eva tena bahudhaiṣa kṛtaḥ kriyāyāḥ /
vyāpārakalpanāvaśān niyatiprapañcaḥ svalpetaratvakṛtatādṛśabhogayogaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1128]
quick_english: The pure reality shines as filled with the three powers and as paired. From this, ritual action is conceived in many ways, and so an expanse of restriction arises that brings about limited forms of enjoyment.

tokens.grounds: compound describing the pure as pervaded by three powers
indeclinable particle introducing an objection or emphasis
adjective referring to the Yāmala character
sandhi fusion of bahudhā and eṣaḥ
compound describing the regulated expanse as linked to limited enjoyment

label: AgMsv_1.1129
cite_parts:
mudrāmaṇḍalasaṃghātaḥ samantratantracarcitaḥ /
yatra yogādikaṃ sarvaṃ phaladānāya kalpate // [AgMsv_1.1129]
quick_english: Where the assemblage of seals and mandalas is practiced together with mantras and tantras, all practices such as yoga become capable of yielding their fruits.

label: AgMsv_1.1130
cite_parts:
nirvṛtiphalasaṃprāptikāṅkṣāsaṃkocasusthitāḥ /
anavacchinnatām eva phalatvenātra manvate // [AgMsv_1.1130]
quick_english: Those who are fixed in the narrowed desire to attain liberation regard unlimitedness itself as the fruit to be obtained here.

tokens.grounds: compound describing practitioners whose aspiration is narrowed to liberation as a result
sandhi fusion of phalatvena and atra

label: AgMsv_1.1132
cite_parts:
na hy anantānav/yacchede kāpi yāgādikalpanā anavacchinnavāñchā // 1.1131 //

tatsarvottīrṇadṛṣṭayaḥ /
tathāpi vidite hy arthe paramādvayasundare // [AgMsv_1.1132]
quick_english: In what is unlimited and unbroken, there is no room for conceiving sacrifice and similar rites; such is the view of those who have transcended all that. Still, even when the supremely nondual reality is known, some desire for a fruit can remain.

tokens.grounds: locative compound; slash in source marks an editorial reading boundary
sandhi fusion of kā and api
editorial reference marker in the text

label: AgMsv_1.1133
cite_parts:
saṃvitsvabhāvasvātantryāt keṣāṃcit phalakāmatā /
tāny evoddiśya tat sarvaṃ pūraṇāya dharāditaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1133]
quick_english: Because consciousness is free by its very nature, some people still desire fruits. For their sake, the entire teaching is set forth, from earth up to Śiva, so that their aims may be fulfilled.

tokens.grounds: accusative plural demonstrative, sandhi form of tāni
gerund with sandhi fusion of eva and uddiśya
ablative compound indicating the starting point of the hierarchy

label: AgMsv_1.1134
cite_parts:
śivāntaṃ bahudhā bhedair dhāraṇāgrantha ucyate

iha hi nānyanayeṣv iva kiñcana sphuritam asti na yat kila satyataḥ /
tad iha satyapade sthitibhāgināṃ kim iva heyapade nipatiṣyati // [AgMsv_1.1134]
quick_english: The teaching on concentrations sets out the whole range up to Śiva in many divisions. Here, unlike in other systems, nothing that appears is unreal; so for those who abide in truth, what could possibly fall into the category of what must be rejected?

tokens.grounds: compound subject, sandhi form of dhāraṇāgranthaḥ
sandhi fusion of na, anya, nayeṣu
relative pronoun, sandhi form of yad

label: AgMsv_1.1135
cite_parts:
itthaṃ saptadaśādhikāracaramaṃ tattvaṃ yad ābhāsate tan nirṇītam anuttaraṃ śivapadaṃ saṃprāptikāmān prati /
etat sarvam ihoditaṃ ca jagadānande vipakṣātmakaṃ bhedaprāṇatayā yato 'tra nikhilo 'py eṣa prapañcaḥ sthitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1135]
quick_english: Thus the principle that appears as the culmination of the seventeen sections is determined to be the unsurpassed state of Śiva for those who desire attainment. Everything taught here appears in an opposing form, because this entire expanse stands animated by difference.

tokens.grounds: relative pronoun, sandhi form of yad
demonstrative pronoun, sandhi form of tat
demonstrative pronoun, sandhi form of etad
sandhi fusion of iha and uditam
locative compound referring to the text or state

label: AgMsv_2.1
cite_parts:
dvitīyaḥ kāṇḍaḥ

evaṃ maheśvaro devo viśvātmatvena saṃsthitaḥ /
kramikajñānayogābhyāṃ dhāraṇābhir upāsyate // [AgMsv_2.1]
quick_english: Thus, in the second section, the great Lord is established as the self of all and is worshiped through gradual knowledge and yoga, and through concentrations.

label: AgMsv_2.2
cite_parts:
tattvakramaṃ gatadvaitamalamāyādijālakam /
aṣṭādaśe tat paṭale tattvaṃ samyag vibhāvyate // [AgMsv_2.2]
quick_english: In the eighteenth chapter, the sequence of principles is fully expounded as freed from the net of duality, impurity, māyā, and the like.

tokens.grounds: indeclinable adverb, sandhi form of samyak

label: AgMsv_2.3
cite_parts:
prāṇāyāmādikaṃ yatra heyam ity eva varṇyate /
na hi tasya parāṃ vittiṃ prati kācid upāyatā // [AgMsv_2.3]
quick_english: Here, practices such as breath control are described as to be abandoned, because they are not a means to supreme knowledge.

tokens.grounds: indefinite pronoun, sandhi form of kācit

label: AgMsv_2.4
cite_parts:
antaḥ saṃvidi yan nirūḍham abhitas tat prāṇadhīvigrahe saṃcāryeta kathaṃ tatheti ghaṭatām abhyāsayogakramaḥ /
ye tv abhyāsapathena saṃvidam imāṃ saṃskartum abhyudyatās te kiṃ kutra kutaḥ kathaṃ vidadhatām ity atra saṃdihmahe // [AgMsv_2.4]
quick_english: What is firmly established within consciousness cannot be moved into the apparatus of breath and mind; so how could a method of practice make that happen? If some still strive to refine consciousness through practice, we doubt what they could accomplish, where, from what basis, and how.

tokens.grounds: relative pronoun, sandhi form of yad
sandhi fusion of tathā and iti
nominative plural participle, sandhi form of abhyudyatāḥ

label: AgMsv_2.5
cite_parts:
abhyāso hi punaḥ punar arthaḥ so 'pi ca dikkālapratibhedāt /
ābhāsetarayogasamuttho dehamanaḥprāṇākṣapathe syāt // [AgMsv_2.5]
quick_english: Practice means doing something over and over again, and even that arises from differences of space and time and from involvement with appearance and otherness; so it takes place on the path of body, mind, breath, and senses.

tokens.grounds: adverb of repetition, sandhi before arthaḥ
predicate noun in compound sense with repetition

label: AgMsv_2.6
cite_parts:
prakāśaikaghane rūpe bhairavīye vivikṣavaḥ /
sakṛdvibhātavijñānaviśrāntyaiva susaṃsthitāḥ // [AgMsv_2.6]
quick_english: Those who wish to enter the Bhairava form, which is dense with pure light alone, become firmly established simply by resting in knowledge that shines forth once.

tokens.grounds: predicate describing those who wish to enter

label: AgMsv_2.7
cite_parts:
atraivātaḥ paraṃ proktam aṅgaṃ sarvopakāri yat /
dhāraṇā api taddvāraniścitāḥ syus tathātmikāḥ // [AgMsv_2.7]
quick_english: For that reason, concentration is declared here to be the supreme and universally helpful limb, and concentrations determined through that same door may become of that very nature.

tokens.grounds: atra + eva + ataḥ fused in sandhi

label: AgMsv_2.8
cite_parts:
nanv apratiṣṭhe kas tarke samāśvāsaḥ prakalpyatām /
kiṃ vā na bhavatāṃ tādṛg apratiṣṭhāhataṃ vacaḥ // [AgMsv_2.8]
quick_english: But surely, what confidence can be placed in reasoning that has no firm ground? Or else, why would your own statement not be struck down by the same lack of ground?

label: AgMsv_2.9
cite_parts:
tathā hy āgama evaikaṃ pramāṇam iti niścitaiḥ /
tadviruddhāgamavrāte sati niścīyatāṃ katham // [AgMsv_2.9]
quick_english: Likewise, if some insist that scripture alone is the valid means of knowledge, how is certainty to be reached when there is a whole host of scriptures that contradict it?

tokens.grounds: explanatory particle, sandhi form of hi

label: AgMsv_2.10
cite_parts:
mahājanaprasiddhis tu tatra prāmāṇyakāraṇam /
apratiṣṭhā tadviruddhamahājanasusaṃbhavāt // [AgMsv_2.10]
quick_english: But if acceptance by the great multitude is taken as the reason for validity, that too is ungrounded, because a great multitude opposed to it can just as well exist.

label: AgMsv_2.11
cite_parts:
pratyakṣam api rucyādau dṛṣṭabādhakasaṃvidam /
uttarottaravijñānānavasthābhājanaṃ nanu // [AgMsv_2.11]
quick_english: Even perception, in matters like taste and so on, is seen to be overruled, and it becomes subject to an endless regress of later cognitions, does it not?

label: AgMsv_2.12
cite_parts:
svasaṃvid api tatraiva bādhiteti kathaṃ kila /
vyavahāram ayaṃ kuryād bhedasaṃdhānapaṇḍitaḥ // [AgMsv_2.12]
quick_english: If even self-awareness were overruled in that way, how could this person, skilled in joining differences together, carry on any practical dealings at all?

tokens.grounds: subject, the expert in joining differences

label: AgMsv_2.13
cite_parts:
asmākaṃ tv apratiṣṭhānaṃ na kadācit kvacid bhavet /
yeṣāṃ sarvatra saṃpūrṇaḥ paro bhairavasāgaraḥ // [AgMsv_2.13]
quick_english: But for us there can never be groundlessness at any time or place, because for us the supreme, all-full ocean of Bhairava is present everywhere.

tokens.grounds: possessive reference to the Trika position
contrastive particle, sandhi form of tu
ultimate ground of certainty; compound: bhairava-sāgara

label: AgMsv_2.14
cite_parts:
viśeṣatas tu tarkasya tān praty evāpratiṣṭhatā /
ye tarkārṇavatārāttaparamāmṛtasaṃvidaḥ // [AgMsv_2.14]
quick_english: Especially for those whose awareness has received the supreme nectar by crossing the ocean of reasoning, reasoning itself is not ungrounded.

tokens.grounds: relative pronoun introducing the qualified group

label: AgMsv_2.15
cite_parts:
tathā hi sarve tarkāṃśā anāmṛṣṭasvasaṃvidaḥ /
sarvatra paryantaphalaṃ na śivaṃ pratipedire // [AgMsv_2.15]
quick_english: For all the parts of reasoning that do not touch self-awareness never, anywhere, attain Śiva as their final fruit.

label: AgMsv_2.16
cite_parts:
abhedasāraḥ sarvo hi śāstrārthas tatprapattaye /
yas tatrodbhāvito bhedas tatra mūḍhadhiyo ratāḥ // [AgMsv_2.16]
quick_english: The meaning of all scripture is essentially non-difference; any difference brought forth there is for attaining that non-difference, yet those of deluded intellect take delight in the difference itself.

tokens.grounds: describes bheda; tatra + udbhāvitaḥ in sandhi
subject who delight in difference; compound: mūḍha-dhī

label: AgMsv_2.17
cite_parts:
tarkaś ca bhedavādāṃśayukticchedaikapaṇḍitaḥ /
nanv abhede 'pi tarkasya kā cid asty upayogitā // [AgMsv_2.17]
quick_english: Reasoning is skilled only in cutting down the arguments of views based on difference; but surely, does reasoning have any usefulness even in the realm of non-difference?

label: AgMsv_2.18
cite_parts:
paramādvayadṛṣṭau ca so 'pi naiva na saṃgataḥ /
ata eva parādvaitaṃ yad viśvānugrahātmakam /
tasyopāyaṃ paraṃ brūte hṛdayaṃ spandanātmakam // [AgMsv_2.18]
quick_english: In the vision of supreme nonduality, even reasoning is not truly fitting; therefore, for that supreme nonduality whose nature is grace to the universe, the text declares the Heart, whose nature is vibration, to be the supreme means.

tokens.grounds: object characterized by the relative clause

label: AgMsv_2.19
cite_parts:
hṛdaye bodhamaye yaḥ svavimarśaḥ pūrṇaciccamatkāraḥ /
yugapad drāgiti haṭhato līnīkṛtaviśvataḥsphuraṇaḥ // [AgMsv_2.19]
quick_english: In the Heart, which is made of awareness, there is a self-reflective awareness, the wonder of full consciousness, which all at once, suddenly and forcibly, dissolves the outward flashing of the universe.

label: AgMsv_2.20
cite_parts:
bhāvagrahādyacaramadaśāyor ullāsinirvṛtisupūrṇaḥ /
jagadānandamayo 'sau sāmānyaspanda ity uktaḥ // [AgMsv_2.20]
quick_english: In the first and last moments of grasping things, that state which is fully filled with surging bliss and made of the bliss of the whole world is called the universal vibration.

tokens.grounds: demonstrative subject, sandhi form of asau

label: AgMsv_2.21
cite_parts:
sphuraṇaṃ hṛdayasya yat kila prakaṭam idaṃ visargadhāmnaḥ /
sad iti pratibhāti yāvatā trikaśaktau viśatīha tāvatā // [AgMsv_2.21]
quick_english: The manifest flashing of the Heart, which shines forth as pure being from the abode of emission, leads one into the triad of powers to the very extent that it is recognized.

label: AgMsv_2.22
cite_parts:
tad idaṃ hṛdayaṃ nirucyate paramaṃ bhairavasaṃvidāmṛtam /
iṣidṛkkṛtiśaktiśūlagaṃ parame dhāmni visṛjyate tataḥ // [AgMsv_2.22]
quick_english: This Heart is defined as the supreme nectar of Bhairava awareness, situated on the trident of the powers of will, knowledge, and action; from the supreme abode it is emitted.

label: AgMsv_2.23
cite_parts:
parame bhagavatparātmani sphuritaṃ viśvam idaṃ cidātmakam /
śaktitrayaśūlagaṃ tataḥ śāmbhavabhūmivisargavartmanā // [AgMsv_2.23]
quick_english: In the supreme, lordly Self this universe flashes forth as consciousness, situated on the trident of the three powers, and then proceeds by the path of emission on the Śāmbhava level.

label: AgMsv_2.24
cite_parts:
tad atho sad iti pragīyate tad idaṃ pūrṇam ihāhamātmakaṃ /
hṛdayaṃ śivaśaktisaṃgamasphuraṇātmaiva sadāvabhāsate // [AgMsv_2.24]
quick_english: That is then proclaimed as pure being; this full Heart, of the nature of 'I', always shines forth as the very flashing of the union of Śiva and Śakti.

tokens.grounds: iha + aham-ātmakaṃ in sandhi; compound: aham-ātmaka

label: AgMsv_2.25
cite_parts:
iha sṛṣṭilayasthitikramāḥ śataśo vāpi sahasrakoṭiśaḥ /
pravibhānti sadātanātmanā haraviṣṇvambujahetusaṃcitāḥ // [AgMsv_2.25]
quick_english: Here, in the Heart, sequences of creation, dissolution, and maintenance shine forth by the hundreds or even by thousands of millions, eternally, gathered through the agencies of Hara, Viṣṇu, and the lotus-born.

tokens.grounds: locative adverb referring to the Heart
adverb of vast multiplicity; compound: sahasra-koṭi-śas

label: AgMsv_2.26
cite_parts:
iha tu puroktād yuktikalāpād yaḥ praviśet sadyo nāśaktaḥ /
taṃ prati śāktopāyapathena prakaṭīkriyate hṛdayaspandaḥ // [AgMsv_2.26]
quick_english: But for one who is not able to enter immediately through the collection of reasonings stated before, the vibration of the Heart is made manifest by the path of the śākta means.

label: AgMsv_2.27
cite_parts:
triśūlaprāntagaprāṇapreraṇāvāptahṛtpathaḥ /
tadantarvarticiccandrakalāviśrāntitatparaḥ // [AgMsv_2.27]
quick_english: One reaches the path of the Heart by impelling the breath at the tip of the trident, and becomes intent on resting in the moon-digit of consciousness within that.

label: AgMsv_2.28
cite_parts:
jhaṭity evātha tadbhūmityāgena projjhya tā daśāḥ /
nirānandādikāḥ pañcabhūtamadhyavyavasthitāḥ // [AgMsv_2.28]
quick_english: Then, suddenly, by abandoning that level and casting off those states beginning with absence of bliss, which are situated amid the five elements, one moves beyond them.

label: AgMsv_2.29
cite_parts:
tyajet pūrvāṃ parāṃ krāmet samyagviśrāntitatparaḥ /
yato nijānandamayī bhūmiḥ śāntapadānugā // [AgMsv_2.29]
quick_english: Intent on complete rest, one should abandon the former stage and move to the higher one, because the ground of innate bliss follows upon the peaceful state.

label: AgMsv_2.30
cite_parts:
nirānandaparānandau puruṣājātasaṃgatau /
abhedabhinnabhogyaughajanitānandajṛmbhaṇāt // [AgMsv_2.30]
quick_english: Nirānanda and parānanda, connected with puruṣa and the unborn, arise from the expansion of bliss produced by masses of undivided and divided objects of experience.

label: AgMsv_2.31
cite_parts:
mahānandasthitiḥ kāpi vāmācārā samullaset /
bhairavīyamahādhāmni svīkṛtāśeṣasaṃvidi // [AgMsv_2.31]
quick_english: A wondrous state of great bliss, of leftward course, shines forth in the great abode of Bhairava, in consciousness that has taken all within itself.

tokens.grounds: describes the mode of the state

label: AgMsv_2.32
cite_parts:
mahānandaś cidānandībhūya bhūyaḥ pravartate /
asmiṃs tu svīkṛtāśeṣadakṣavāmordhvagatrike // [AgMsv_2.32]
quick_english: Great bliss, having become the bliss of consciousness, proceeds again in this triad that has taken in all the right, left, and upper aspects.

label: AgMsv_2.33
cite_parts:
trike sarvātmanā dvaitādvaitasaṃgrahaṇātmani /
abhinnā vātha bhinnā vā bhinnābhinnā athāpi vā // [AgMsv_2.33]
quick_english: In the triad whose nature is to grasp both duality and nonduality in every way, things may appear as undivided, or divided, or both divided and undivided.

label: AgMsv_2.34
cite_parts:
bhāvā nijādikānandadaśāpañcakayojitāḥ /
jāyante jagadānandasamuddāmadaśājuṣaḥ // [AgMsv_2.34]
quick_english: Beings, joined with the five states of bliss beginning with innate bliss, arise from the state of intense, overflowing universal bliss.

label: AgMsv_2.35
cite_parts:
nijānandaḥ pramātraṃśamātraniṣṭhanibandhanaḥ /
śūnyatāmātraviśrānter nirānandātmikā sthitiḥ // [AgMsv_2.35]
quick_english: Innate bliss is founded only on resting in the aspect of the subject, while the state of nirānanda arises from resting only in emptiness.

label: AgMsv_2.36
cite_parts:
prameyapadaviśrānteḥ parānando 'py udety alam /
anantameyasaṃghaṭṭapūrṇe meye tu sarvataḥ // [AgMsv_2.36]
quick_english: Supreme bliss also fully arises from resting in the domain of the object, when the object is filled on all sides with the collision of infinite knowables.

label: AgMsv_2.37
cite_parts:
pramāṇāc carvaṇāyogān mahānanda iti sthitiḥ /
samastamānameyaughakalanāgrāsakovidaḥ // [AgMsv_2.37]
quick_english: The state called great bliss arises from the means of knowing through the yoking of savoring; it is skilled in devouring the apprehension of all masses of knowers and knowns.

tokens.grounds: compound describing the state or experiencer

label: AgMsv_2.38
cite_parts:
yadā viśrāntim abhyeti nirupādhisunirbharām /
tadā khalu cidānando yo jaḍānupabṛṃhitaḥ // [AgMsv_2.38]
quick_english: When one attains a rest that is unconditioned and utterly full, then indeed there is consciousness-bliss, which is not nourished by anything inert.

label: AgMsv_2.39
cite_parts:
na ca yatra sthitiḥ kāpi vibhaktā jaḍarūpiṇī /
yatra ko 'pi vyavacchedo nāsti yad viśvataḥ sphurat // [AgMsv_2.39]
quick_english: Where there is no divided state of inert form, where there is no division at all, and which shines forth on every side.

label: AgMsv_2.40

yad anāhṛtasaṃvitti paramāmṛtabṛṃhitam /
tad eva jagadānandadhāmāsmākaṃ gurur jagau // [AgMsv_2.40]
quick_english: Our teacher declared that very reality—unstruck awareness nourished by supreme nectar—to be the abode of universal bliss.

label: AgMsv_2.41

quick_english: Where contemplation and other practices have no primary applicability, rest should be established there through the yoga of utterance in the heart.

object to be established; sandhi for viśrāntiḥ

quick_english: The complete rest attained there is called supreme nonduality; it comes about through the application of the breath-staff and the equalizing of before and after.

tokens.grounds: adverb qualifying rest; sandhi for samyak

label: AgMsv_2.44

quick_english: By the unsurpassed nature that operates through the activity of speech, united with the dissolution and flourishing of the supreme I in the reflective awareness of consciousness.

label: AgMsv_2.45

udyogavaśariktena saddvādaśakalātmanā /
sūryeṇābhāsite bhāve pūrite paricarcite // [AgMsv_2.45]
quick_english: When the entity is illuminated by the sun—emptied of effort and whose nature is the true twelve phases—it is filled and fully pervaded.

label: AgMsv_2.46

tadgrāsamantharavaśāḥ ṣoḍaśākhyakalājuṣā /
praviṣṭeṇa vibodhāgnau samyag visṛjatā kalāḥ // [AgMsv_2.46]
quick_english: Having entered the fire of awakening, the one possessing the sixteen named phases completely releases the phases, which are slowed by the power of devouring that.

label: AgMsv_2.47
cite_parts:
catasro jīvanīḥ prāptavisargāvikṛtasthiteḥ /
antaḥkṛtānantatattvakādikṣāntena sarvataḥ // [AgMsv_2.47]
quick_english: By the one who has internalized the infinite principles from ka to kṣa on all sides, whose state remains unchanged after attaining emission, the four life-giving powers are attained.

label: AgMsv_2.48

bhāvānāṃ bhāvatāsāravimarśābhāvahṛdyujā /
bahiḥprasavasadyogikulanetryadhiśāyinā // [AgMsv_2.48]
quick_english: Joined to the heart where there is no reflection on the essence of the beingness of things, resting upon the eye of the yogin lineage fit for outward emission.

label: AgMsv_2.49
cite_parts:
rudrayāmalabhāvena nityaṃ yā niṣṭhitaiva tām /
citprāṇaguṇadehāntaśaktisopānamālikām // [AgMsv_2.49]
quick_english: By the state of Rudra-union, that stairway-garland of powers—ending in consciousness, breath, quality, and body—is always indeed established.

label: AgMsv_2.50

visargena visṛjyātha spandanodaravartinā /
visargabhūmim āśliṣya matsyodaradaśājuṣam // [AgMsv_2.50]
quick_english: Then, having released through emission moving within the womb of vibration, one embraces the ground of emission, which enjoys the state of the fish-womb.

label: AgMsv_2.51
cite_parts:
sarvasarvagatāṃ sarvajīvanīṃ paramāṃ kalām /
triśūlabhuvam ākramya nāḍītritayasaṃgatām // [AgMsv_2.51]
quick_english: Having ascended the ground of the trident, connected with the three channels, one reaches the supreme phase that is present in all, pervading all, and life-giving to all.

label: AgMsv_2.52

vikasvarāṃ saṃkucitāṃ krameṇaikātmyam āśritām /
bhrūkuṭībindunādāntaśaktisopānamālikām // [AgMsv_2.52]
quick_english: One reaches the stairway-garland of powers ending in the brow-center, bindu, and nāda—expanding and contracting, and resorting in sequence to unity.

quick_english: Therefore, when the yogi, using means grounded in the contemplative body, wishes to enter the supreme, he first trembles.

quick_english: There, in the abodes of bliss of the previously taught seed, womb, parts, and emission, the wise gather an indescribable attainment of identity.

label: AgMsv_2.82
cite_parts:
abhedavṛttitaḥ paśyan dṛśyaṃ citicamatkṛteḥ /
arthakriyārthitādainyakāritāṃ kātarāṃ sthitm // [AgMsv_2.82]
quick_english: Seeing the visible from a stance of non-difference, through the wonder of consciousness, he abandons the timid state that comes from the wretched craving for practical results.

tokens.grounds: object of vihāya (v1152); final consonant cluster as given

label: AgMsv_2.83
cite_parts:
vihāya yāvad āsīta tāvac chāṃbhavabhūmikām /
bhairavīm āviśaty eva parāṃ bhūmim ayatnataḥ // [AgMsv_2.83]
quick_english: Having abandoned that state, as long as he remains so, he effortlessly enters the Bhairava-like Śāmbhava level, the supreme state.

tokens.grounds: compound object of āviśati: śāmbhava-bhūmikā (initial ch- as given)
present participle/verb form in sandhi context (āviśati)

label: AgMsv_2.84
cite_parts:
etadāviṣṭasaṃvitti sarvam eva nirīkṣyate /
prakāśarūpatākrāntaṃ caitanyaṃ hi prakāśate // [AgMsv_2.84]
quick_english: For one whose awareness is entered by this state, everything is seen as pervaded by the nature of light, for it is consciousness that shines.

label: AgMsv_2.85
cite_parts:
na cāprakāśaṃ prākāśyayogād eti prakāśatām /
iti vistarataḥ pūrvaṃ prakāśitam idaṃ yataḥ // [AgMsv_2.85]
quick_english: And what is unmanifest does not attain manifestation merely by being connected with something to be manifested; this has already been explained at length.

label: AgMsv_2.86
cite_parts:
mahāsāhasasaṃyogavilīnākhilavṛttikaḥ /
puñjībhūtasvaraśmyoghanirbharībhūtamānasaḥ // [AgMsv_2.86]
quick_english: All his activities dissolved through union with great audacity, his mind becomes wholly filled by a concentrated mass of his own rays.

label: AgMsv_2.87
cite_parts:
akiṃciccintakaḥ spaṣṭadṛṣṭabhedojjhitasthitiḥ /
yāvad āsīta tāvat tu pūrvoktā eva bhūmayaḥ // [AgMsv_2.87]
quick_english: Thinking of nothing and having abandoned the state of clearly seen difference, as long as he remains so, the previously described levels come forward.

label: AgMsv_2.88
cite_parts:
sāṃmukhyaṃ yānti saṃsārasadmadāhaikahetavaḥ /
yaś ca divyo 'kṣasaṃghāto bhedarūḍhitirohitaḥ // [AgMsv_2.88]
quick_english: Those levels come into presence as the sole causes for burning away the intoxication of worldly existence, and so does the divine aggregate of senses that had been overgrown by the firm sense of difference.

tokens.grounds: compound: akṣa-saṃghāta; initial apostrophe marks elision

label: AgMsv_2.89
cite_parts:
svātantryapoṣakakrīḍāmātropakaraṇātmakaḥ /
yadā nimīlanāvandhyas tiṣṭhaty ekaṃ kṣaṇaṃ tadā // [AgMsv_2.89]
quick_english: When that aggregate, whose nature is play that nourishes freedom, remains fruitfully turned inward for even a single moment, then—

label: AgMsv_2.90
cite_parts:
taddvāroditasaṃbodhamahājvālāvilāpitam /
viśvam abhyeti paramānandasāgaraśāyitām // [AgMsv_2.90]
quick_english: Then the universe, melted by the great flame of awareness that has arisen through that door, attains the state of resting in the ocean of supreme bliss.

label: AgMsv_2.91
cite_parts:
tadrasāpānaviśrāntaḥ saṃviddevīḥ pratarpayan /
acirād eti maraṇajanmatrāsavihīnatām // [AgMsv_2.91]
quick_english: Resting in the drinking of that savor and satisfying the goddesses of awareness, he soon attains freedom from the fear of death and birth.

label: AgMsv_2.92
cite_parts:
āśyānabhāvaṃ hi gatā svasaṃviddehendriyajñeyamayatvam āptā /
yuktyā tu sā prāptavilīnabhāvāt saṃvidghanaṃ svaṃ vapur eva yāti // [AgMsv_2.92]
quick_english: For awareness, having congealed and taken on the form of its own awareness, body, senses, and objects, returns by the proper method—once that state has dissolved—to its own dense body of consciousness.

label: AgMsv_2.93
cite_parts:
yuktyā yayaiva bāhyārthavivaśīkṛtacetasām /
vyutthitir jāyate saiva bhairavānandasaṃvidaḥ // [AgMsv_2.93]
quick_english: By the very same method through which those whose minds are overpowered by external objects emerge outward, there arises the awareness of Bhairava's bliss.

label: AgMsv_2.94
cite_parts:
tayaiva yoginīvaktrasaṃpradāyakramāptayā /
vidhūtakalmaṣāveśā tiṣṭhate cinmayī sthitiḥ // [AgMsv_2.94]
quick_english: By that very method, received through the lineage of the yoginī's mouth, the entry of impurity is shaken off and the state made of consciousness stands firm.

label: AgMsv_2.95
cite_parts:
vaktram īṣad yadā yogī vikāsayati saṃvidaḥ /
sarvā indriyanāḍyantaścakrākramaṇasaṃśrayāḥ // [AgMsv_2.95]
quick_english: When the yogin slightly opens the mouth of awareness, all the inner circles of the senses and channels, resting on that traversal, are activated.

label: AgMsv_2.96
cite_parts:
tadā vikāsaṃ grāhyārthabhedābhāvamayaṃ haṭhāt /
prayānti cidunmukhatvāt nīlapītādibhedavān // [AgMsv_2.96]
quick_english: Then, because of turning toward consciousness, they suddenly move into an expansion consisting in the absence of difference among grasped objects, even though differences like blue and yellow had appeared.

label: AgMsv_2.97
cite_parts:
grāhyagrāhakasaṃbandhabhedaḥ sapadi bhidyate /
yoginīvaktrasaṃrūḍhasaṃpradāyakramāptayā // [AgMsv_2.97]
quick_english: The difference in the relation between grasper and grasped is split at once through attainment of the lineage rooted in the yoginī's mouth.

label: AgMsv_2.98
cite_parts:
sadyo 'nubhavadāyinyā mudrayā mudritākhilaḥ /
sarvādhiṣṭhātṛcidrūpasākṣādbhairavatandritaḥ // [AgMsv_2.98]
quick_english: Immediately, by the experience-giving seal, he is wholly sealed and absorbed in direct Bhairava, the consciousness-form that presides over all.

label: AgMsv_2.99
cite_parts:
sa yogī vismayāviṣṭo labhate svātmasaṃvidam /
tattaddṛśyodayāpāyayoge 'py anapayatsthiti // [AgMsv_2.99]
quick_english: That yogin, filled with wonder, obtains awareness of his own self and remains in a state that does not depart even amid the arising and passing of various objects.

label: AgMsv_2.100
cite_parts:
taḍāgavartinimnāmbu tannānyatra pravartate /
prayatnenāpi tanmātrapūraṇāya yad akṣamam // [AgMsv_2.100]
quick_english: Water lying low in a tank does not flow elsewhere, even with effort, because it is incapable of doing more than filling that place alone.

tokens.grounds: adjective explaining why it does not flow elsewhere

label: AgMsv_2.101
cite_parts:
yadā tvantaḥdvāravāridhārasaṃpūritaṃ rasāt /
bhaved bhaveyustatpūrṇāḥ pravāhāḥ sarvatomukhāḥ // [AgMsv_2.101]
quick_english: But when it is filled with savor by a stream of water flowing through the inner door, then streams filled by that overflow in all directions.

label: AgMsv_2.102
cite_parts:
evaṃ svollāsarabhasāc caitanyaṃ pronmiṣatsvayaṃ /
avibhāgena bhāvāṃśān svātmābhedena bhāsayan // [AgMsv_2.102]
quick_english: Thus, by the force of its own surge, consciousness opens forth by itself and, without division, makes the portions of beings shine as non-different from its own self.

label: AgMsv_2.103
cite_parts:
mīlanāviṣayībhāvaṃ śrayed yadi muhūrtakaṃ /
māyāvigalanād bhūmir bhairavīyā virājate // [AgMsv_2.103]
quick_english: If, even for a moment, it does not sink into closure, then through the dissolving of māyā the level of Bhairava shines forth.

label: AgMsv_2.104
cite_parts:
vaikalpiko 'hyavacchedaḥ paścād yāṃ darśayed bhidām /
saiva māyā svatantrasya bhedadṛṣṭiprakāśinī // [AgMsv_2.104]
quick_english: For the limitation born of conceptualization may afterward show division; that very division is māyā, the power of the free one that reveals the vision of difference.

tokens.grounds: optative of dṛś in causative sense

label: AgMsv_2.105
cite_parts:
unmeṣamātrarūḍhasya sā nirmūlā na saṃbhavet /
itthaṃ kiṃ bahunoktena naye 'nuttarātmani // [AgMsv_2.105]
quick_english: For one who rests only in the opening of consciousness, that māyā is rootless and cannot arise; so what is the use of saying more in this method of the unsurpassed self?

label: AgMsv_2.106
cite_parts:
vastuto 'sti na kasyāpi yogāṅgasyābhyupāyatā /
svarūpaṃ hyasya nīrūpam avacchedavivarjanāt // [AgMsv_2.106]
quick_english: In reality, no limb of yoga can serve as a means, for its own nature is formless, being free from all limitation.

tokens.grounds: asti with initial a elided in text

label: AgMsv_2.107
cite_parts:
upāya 'pyanupāyo 'syāyāgavṛttinirodhataḥ /
recanapūraṇair eṣā rahitā tanuvātanauḥ // [AgMsv_2.107]
quick_english: Even the means is not a means, because it stops effortful activity; it is free from exhalation and inhalation and from the regulation of body and breath.

tokens.grounds: refers to the state or practice

label: AgMsv_2.108
cite_parts:
tārayaty evam ātmānaṃ bhedasāgaragocarāt /
nimajjamānam apy etan mano vaiṣayike rase // [AgMsv_2.108]
quick_english: Thus this mind carries the self across from the ocean of difference, even when it is sinking while still in the taste of objects.

tokens.grounds: present of tṛ in causative sense

label: AgMsv_2.109
cite_parts:
nāntarārdratvam abhyeti niśchidraṃ tumbakaṃ yathā /
svaṃ panthānaṃ hayasyeva manaso ye nirundhate // [AgMsv_2.109]
quick_english: A gourd without holes does not become soft inside; likewise, those who forcibly restrain the mind's own path, as if holding back a horse, do not make it inwardly receptive.

label: AgMsv_2.110
cite_parts:
teṣāṃ tatkhaṇḍanayogād dhavaty unmārgakoṭibhiḥ /
kiṃsvid etad iti prāyo duḥkhe 'py utkaṇṭhate manaḥ // [AgMsv_2.110]
quick_english: For those who try to break the mind, it runs off along countless wrong paths; wondering, 'What is this?', the mind mostly keeps longing restlessly, even in pain.

label: AgMsv_2.111
cite_parts:
sukhād api virajyeta jñānād etad idaṃ [tv iti] /
tathāhi gurur ādikṣad bahudhā svakaśāsane // [AgMsv_2.111]
quick_english: Through knowledge one can become dispassionate even toward pleasure, discerning 'this is this'; for the teacher has taught this in many ways in his own scripture.

label: AgMsv_2.112
cite_parts:
anādaraviraktyaiva galantīndriyavṛttayaḥ /
yāvat tu viniyamyante tāvat tāvad vikurvate // [AgMsv_2.112]
quick_english: The activities of the senses fall away through indifference and dispassion alone; but as long as they are forcibly controlled, they keep acting turbulently.

label: AgMsv_2.113
cite_parts:
pratyāhāro 'pi nāmāyaṃ yo 'kṣajāle pravartyate /
bandhasyārūḍhavṛttes tad vajralepena bandhanam // [AgMsv_2.113]
quick_english: Even that so-called withdrawal which is applied to the net of the senses becomes, for one whose bondage is already firmly set, a binding as hard as diamond cement.

tokens.grounds: akṣa+jāla compound with initial a elided

label: AgMsv_2.114
cite_parts:
artheṣu tadbhogavidhau tadutthe \ \ duḥkhe sukhe vā galitābhiśaṅkam /
anāviśanto 'pi nimagnacittā \ \ jānanti vṛttikṣayasaukhyam antaḥ // [AgMsv_2.114]
quick_english: Amid objects, their enjoyment, and the pleasure or pain that arises from them, those whose fear has dissolved, though their minds are immersed, do not truly enter into them and know within the ease of the quieting of mental activity.

tokens.grounds: present participle of ā+viś with negation

label: AgMsv_2.115
cite_parts:
saty evātmani citsvabhāvamahasi svānte tathopakriyāṃ tasmai kurvati tatpracāracature saty akṣavarge 'pi ca /
satsv artheṣu rasādiṣu sphuṭataraṃ yad bhedavandhyodayaṃ yogī tiṣṭhati pūrṇaraśmikhacitas tat tattvam ādīyatām // [AgMsv_2.115]
quick_english: When the self, the great light of consciousness, is present in the heart, and the senses and objects such as taste are also present and active, the yogi abides very clearly in a fullness whose arising is free of difference; let that reality be accepted.

tokens.grounds: locative plural participle form as given

label: AgMsv_2.116
cite_parts:
aviveka eva param iha saṃsāra iti pravādamātram /
aviveka eva hi paraṃ niḥśreyasalābhasopānam // [AgMsv_2.116]
quick_english: To say that non-discrimination is supreme bondage is only a common saying; for non-discrimination itself can be the supreme stairway to attaining liberation.

label: AgMsv_2.117
cite_parts:
tyajāvadhānāni nanu kva nāma dhatse 'vadhānaṃ vicinu svayaṃ tat /
pūrṇe 'vadhānaṃ nahi nāma yuktaṃ nāpūrṇam abhyeti ca satyabhāvam // [AgMsv_2.117]
quick_english: Abandon deliberate concentrations; where, indeed, would you place concentration? Examine it yourself: in the full it is not fitting, and in the not-full it does not attain true being.

tokens.grounds: tyaja+avadhānāni fused in text, command plus object

label: AgMsv_2.118
cite_parts:
yatraivānandayogaḥ kvacana nanu bhavet tatra pūrṇaḥ svabhāvaḥ --- --- te veti tatra praśamapadam iyād yady ayaṃ bhedamohaḥ /
tajjñāne jāgradādāv api nikhilapade cinmahācakranātho yogī jāyeta nānāvyavahṛtapathago 'pyullasan mantravīryaḥ // [AgMsv_2.118]
quick_english: Wherever union with bliss arises, there one's own nature is full; if the delusion of difference is understood, one may reach peace there. Even in waking and in every state, the yogi can become the lord of the great wheel of consciousness, moving through varied activities while shining with mantra power.

tokens.grounds: editorial lacuna marker in token list
editorial lacuna marker in token list

label: AgMsv_2.119
cite_parts:
yathā hi kūpaṃ pracikīrṣur eva prāpte jale yāti kṛtitvam ekaḥ /
kaścit punar hastagatādi[vāri]mātrād itthaṃ paraprāptividhir vicitraḥ // [AgMsv_2.119]
quick_english: Just as one who sets out to dig a well feels accomplished only when water is reached, while another is satisfied with water already in hand, so the way of attaining the supreme is varied.

label: AgMsv_2.120
cite_parts:
anupāyam idaṃ tasmād upāyopeyayogataḥ /
bhedabandhād vimucyeta kathaṃ vetarathā janaḥ // [AgMsv_2.120]
quick_english: This is without means; so how, by the usual relation of means and goal, or in any other way, could a person be freed from the bondage of difference?

label: AgMsv_2.121
cite_parts:
anupāye 'pi caitasmin kiṃcit sāṃbandhyavṛttitaḥ /
upāyasyopadeśo 'yaṃ śāstre 'tra bahudhā kṛtaḥ // [AgMsv_2.121]
quick_english: Even though this reality is without means, this scripture teaches means in many ways, functioning through relational instruction.

label: AgMsv_2.122
cite_parts:
yathā lipyakṣarair bālāḥ satye varṇātmani sphuṭam /
praveśyante tathā mūḍhais tair aupāyikaiḥ kramāt // [AgMsv_2.122]
quick_english: Just as children are clearly led into the real nature of sound through written letters, so the deluded are gradually led by those provisional means.

label: AgMsv_2.123
cite_parts:
tadartham eva cādvaite paratattve 'pi sādaram /
pūjādhyānādi śāstre 'sminn ucitaṃ kiṃcid ucyate // [AgMsv_2.123]
quick_english: For that very purpose, even in the nondual supreme reality, this scripture respectfully teaches something appropriate, such as worship and meditation.

label: AgMsv_2.124
cite_parts:
yat kiṃcin manasāhlādi yatra kvāpīndriyasthitau /
yojyate bodhasadbrahmadhāmni brahmabilātmani // [AgMsv_2.124]
quick_english: Whatever delights the mind, in any state of the senses, can be joined to the abode of true awareness, to the very opening of Brahman.

label: AgMsv_2.125
cite_parts:
ātmānusārisadbhāvasamāveśadaśāśrayāt

tattatparakuleśānaśakticakrārcanākrame /
prayāty evāprayatnena karaṇatvaṃ svabhāvataḥ // [AgMsv_2.125]
quick_english: Resting on absorption in true being that follows the self, one naturally and without effort comes to function as an instrument in the worship of the wheel of the supreme Kula lord and his powers.

label: AgMsv_2.126
cite_parts:
kṛtvādhāradharāṃ camatkṛtirasaprokṣākṣaṇakṣālitām āttair mānasataḥ svabhāvakusumaiḥ svāmodasaṃdohibhiḥ /
ānandāmṛtanirbharasvahṛdayānarghārghapātrakramāt tvāṃ devyā saha dehadevasadane devārcaye 'harniśam // [AgMsv_2.126]
quick_english: Having made the support-ground cleansed by a moment of sprinkling with the essence of wonder, I worship you, O God, together with the Goddess day and night in the temple of the body, using flowers of my own nature taken from the mind and filled with their own fragrance, through the method of the priceless offering-vessel of my own heart overflowing with the nectar of bliss.

label: AgMsv_2.127
cite_parts:
evaṃ yatra kvacit tiṣṭhet svavimarśasvabhāvataḥ /
tatra śaktitrayāveśas tridhā tāvat prakāśate // [AgMsv_2.127]
quick_english: Thus, wherever one may stand, by the very nature of one's own reflective awareness, there the entry of the three powers shines forth in a threefold way.

label: AgMsv_2.128
cite_parts:
navadhā bhāsamānasya proktadvādaśacakrataḥ /
viśrāntir ekakṣaṇagā sāṣṭottaraśatasthitiḥ // [AgMsv_2.128]
quick_english: When that shining appears ninefold, arising from the stated twelve wheels, its repose occurs in a single moment and takes the form of a state numbering one hundred and eight.

label: AgMsv_2.129
cite_parts:
ekaiva śatasaṃkhyā ca sā sthitiḥ pravibhāvyate /
itthaṃ yat kiṃcanaitasya vacanaṃ yogino bhavet // [AgMsv_2.129]
quick_english: That state is clearly discerned as one alone, numbering a hundred; and in this way, whatever speech at all may arise from this yogin belongs to that same state.

label: AgMsv_2.130
cite_parts:
tad eva japayogāya jāyate 'nuttare pathi /
antarindhanasadbhāvam anapekṣyaiva nityaśaḥ // [AgMsv_2.130]
quick_english: That very speech becomes mantra practice on the unsurpassed path, constantly and without any need to rely on the presence of inner fuel.

label: AgMsv_2.131
cite_parts:
yo jvalaty akhilākṣaughaprasṛtāgraśikhāśataḥ /
tatraiva sarvabhāvānāṃ praveśaś ced vimṛśyate // [AgMsv_2.131]
quick_english: If one reflectively understands that all beings enter into that which blazes with hundreds of foremost flames spreading forth from all the streams of the senses, then that very place is where their entry occurs.
